stats.notes: No Common Data Set was found on lewisu.edu, so the figures come from other sources: first-year applicants, admits and enrolled students and the average GPA (3.57) are from Lewis Quick Facts (fall 2024); test percentiles and submission rates (SAT 24%, ACT 4% of enrolled) are IPEDS fall 2024 figures via College Navigator. Quick Facts also gives averages (ACT 23.7, SAT 1084) and says 3.6% of the first-year class is international; international applicant/admit counts are not published. Undergraduate enrollment 4,326 is fall 2024.

cost.notes: Tuition $20,950 per semester (12-18 credits, traditional undergraduate, fall 2026/spring 2027); student fee $250 per semester; room is a first-year double ($3,742 per semester) plus default Meal Plan II ($2,835 per semester). Books are the College Navigator 2024-25 estimate. A total cost of attendance is not published on the pages reviewed, so none is given
